programmes.d: Hunter's vacation is shattered when he falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson scheme he's investigating.
McCall lands in hot water when she reopens the case her husband was working on when he was killed.
Tony and Paulie investigate a puzzling arson case in which the husband of a beautiful woman appears to have been murdered.
Tony winds up in one of his own jail cells when he runs afoul of an imperious judge who's hiding a fearsome secret.
Tony attempts to protect an informant from a mysterious hit man, while Stan Kelly enjoys a romantic encounter with a beautiful new Eastbridge arrival.
Vinnie's resignation from the Organized Crime Bureau leads him home and into a hotbed of racial hatred.
Vinnie returns to the O.C.B. on his own terms, determined to infiltrate the radical racist organization that has threatened his family and friends.
The local police leave their kid gloves behind when they haul Vinnie in, mistakenly believing he has murdered one of their own.
Sergeant McCall poses as a fashion model to expose a burglary ring preying on wealthy businessmen.
Hunter and McCall pose as husband and wife to investigate the murder of a young girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot to relocate secret agents in the United States.
A concert pianist is paralyzed by fear when a man jailed for her attempted murder is released from prison and vows to complete the task.
